changeSet.author: Tomislav Duric
changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.fulltext_stoplists where name='emptyStopList') BEGIN CREATE FULLTEXT STOPLIST emptyStopList; END ALTER FULLTEXT INDEX ON graph.AssetNode SET STOPLIST = emptyStopList
changeSet.rollback: ALTER FULLTEXT INDEX ON graph.AssetNode SET STOPLIST = SYSTEM IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.fulltext_stoplists where name='emptyStopList') BEGIN DROP FULLTEXT STOPLIST emptyStopList; END
